patterns.note: Sections are delineated by alternating full-width background colors, creating clear visual breaks between content blocks.
A highly stylized, custom-designed display typeface is used exclusively for the hero section's brand name, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for all other headings and body text.
A vibrant, almost neon green is used as a primary accent and hero background, providing a strong brand identity against a deep charcoal and off-white content palette.
The initial full-screen hero section, featuring a large animated brand name and illustration, is completely replaced by the main page content as the user scrolls down.
The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking from a larger, integrated component within the hero to a compact, sticky bar with a simplified logo and menu icon.
The site uses a distinct, full-width dark footer that includes a large script logo, navigation links, social media, and contact information, clearly separated from the main content.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a large, dynamic element (likely a canvas animation or video, as detected) that initially fills the viewport. On scroll, this immersive hero is entirely removed from view, allowing the main content to take over the screen, creating a dramatic transition.

The primary navigation bar implements a scroll-triggered transformation. It begins as a more expansive element integrated into the hero, then visually shrinks and repositions to become a sticky, compact header at the top of the viewport, maintaining persistent access to navigation.

Content sections are presented with clear visual separation through alternating background colors. Elements within these sections appear to scroll into view without complex individual reveal animations, relying on the overall page scroll for content progression.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very oversized, bold, custom display font for the hero (~8-10x body) with smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels (~0.7x body) and clear, readable sans-serif headings (~2-3x body).
design_tokens.radius: Rounded for the custom display font in the hero, subtle for buttons and card corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with an airy hero section and a slightly denser but still comfortable content grid.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, illustrative, and highly animated hero section, which uses a unique, custom-designed display typeface and playful graphics to immediately establish a memorable brand identity before transitioning to a more conventional content layout. This creates a strong, playful first impression that sets it apart from typical agency sites.
